Monaer brake pads and discs for workshops in Kedah

Supplied from our Skudai, Johor base. Send the car or the part number on WhatsApp.

Check my car on WhatsAppCall 016-759 5988

For workshops in Alor Setar, Sungai Petani and Kulim, send the car or the box label on WhatsApp and we confirm the Monaer part and stock in Skudai.

We are based in Skudai, Johor. We do not have a branch in Kedah, and we only list workshops that have joined the Monaer network.

What we supply to Kedah

  • Nano ceramic brake pads

    Monaer pads for daily cars, premium models and EVs, each set with cleaner spray, gloves and anti-noise grease.

  • Coated brake discs

    High-carbon drilled and slotted discs with an anti-rust coating, sold as a left and right pair.

  • Brake fluid and care

    DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid and brake care items for the same job.

Brake pads Brake discs

Real Monaer stock, ready in Skudai

Boxes from our own shelves. Each label shows the Monaer part number and the cars it fits.

How ordering works from Kedah

  1. 1

    Send the car or part number

    Make, model, year and front or rear. A photo of the old pad or its box label is fastest.

  2. 2

    We match and check stock

    We match the Monaer number to the car and confirm what is on our Skudai shelves.

  3. 3

    We agree how it reaches you

    We confirm the way the parts get to your workshop in Kedah before you pay.

Questions drivers and workshops ask

Do you supply Monaer brake parts to workshops in Kedah?

Yes. S & P Precision Parts supplies Monaer brake pads and discs to workshops in Kedah from our base in Skudai, Johor. WhatsApp us the car or the part number to start.

Can a driver in Kedah buy Monaer pads?

Ask us on WhatsApp with your car and your town. We match the part and tell you how to get it fitted near you.
